mapper.select: SELECT m.meal_slot_code,m.meal_slot_name,m.slot_kind,COALESCE(st.display_order,m.display_order+100) display_order FROM the_full_order.tb_meal_slot_master m LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_slot_setting st ON st.account_id=#{account_id} AND st.meal_slot_code=m.meal_slot_code WHERE st.account_id IS NOT NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s WHERE s.table_id=#{table_id} AND s.meal_slot_code=m.meal_slot_code AND s.status<>'CANCELED') ORDER BY display_order,m.meal_slot_code

SELECT s.meal_service_id,s.meal_date,s.meal_slot_code,s.planned_servings FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s WHERE s.table_id=#{table_id} AND s.status<>'CANCELED' AND s.meal_slot_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.meal_date,s.meal_slot_code

SELECT d.meal_service_id,d.menu_id,d.menu_name,d.sort_order FROM the_full_order.tb_account_table_meals_detail d JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s ON s.meal_service_id=d.meal_service_id WHERE d.table_id=#{table_id} AND s.status<>'CANCELED' ORDER BY d.meal_service_id,d.sort_order

SELECT r.meal_service_id,r.menu_id,r.ingredient_id,r.total_required_qty,r.base_unit, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.product_name_snapshot,''),lot.product_name_snapshot,p.product_name, ai.ingredient_name_std,ai.ingredient_name_raw,i.ingredient_name_std,i.ingredient_name_raw,r.ingredient_id) item_name, p.package_qty,p.package_unit,p.order_unit, (SELECT MIN(rd.ingredient_seq) FROM the_full_order.tb_account_recipe_detail rd WHERE rd.account_id=s.account_id AND rd.menu_id=r.menu_id AND rd.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id) ingredient_seq FROM the_full_order.tb_account_meal_ingredient_requirement r JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_meal_service s ON s.meal_service_id=r.meal_service_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_master ai ON ai.account_id=s.account_id AND ai.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_ingredient_master i ON i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot lot ON lot.inventory_lot_id=( SELECT l.inventory_lot_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.account_id=s.account_id AND l.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id ORDER BY l.received_date DESC,l.inventory_lot_id DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=lot.supplier_product_id WHERE s.table_id=#{table_id} AND s.status<>'CANCELED' ORDER BY r.meal_service_id,r.menu_id,ingredient_seq IS NULL,ingredient_seq,r.ingredient_id
